what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/ask-questions-sort-answers-follow-up: make quiz questions, check a form's answers, score answers into a segment (listed from records.json), and keep forms, answers and decisions as the person's own records through the records door.

payload.label: Questions and answers: quiz questions from text, checking form answers, scoring answers into segments
Make a form record
payload.job: Check a form, a list of questions people answer, and give it as one record the person's AI can keep in a store, so it can be asked and its answers checked
payload.description: Give a form_id, an optional title and presentation, and the questions. Each question needs a questionId and a questionTypeId (a row in the question-type list: text, long text, number, rating, choice, a reference to a file) and may carry a label, required, options, its own validation rules laid over its type's, and an afterSaved hand-off naming an owner and an action. Returns the form as one question-sequence record ({ id, type, value }) and how many questions it holds. Nothing is kept: write the record to a store to keep it; the same form_id gives the same record id.

form_id.description: The form's name, kept in the record id

presentation.description: How the form is shown: a mode and the words of its Back, Next and Submit buttons

record.description: The question-sequence record: id, type and value

provenance.source: bitfield-packages packages/ask-questions-sort-answers-follow-up (its record builders and readers); the tools answer their result and keep nothing

payload.label: Check and decide form answers
payload.job: Check a person's answers against a form and, when they are all valid, give the answer records, the score and segment they earn and any follow-up the form hands to its owner
payload.description: Give form_id, respondent_id, answers (questionId to value) and records: the form's question-sequence record and, for deciding the segment, the score-rule, segment-rule and follow-up-sequence records, as a store lists them. Optionally submission_id (for a form answered again and again, so each time has its own records) and answered_at. The answers are checked against the form as check-form-answers does. If any is invalid the first to fix is returned and no records. Otherwise it returns the decision (score and segment), the segment's follow-up sequence, and records: an answer fact for each answer the form asks about, one segment assignment, and one request record for each question whose afterSaved names an owner and action, with the answers filled into its input. Nothing is kept: write the returned records to a store to keep them.

respondent_id.description: Who is answering; answers of one respondent group together

answers.description: Each question's answer, keyed by questionId

submission_id.description: Names this time of answering, so a repeated form keeps every time

records.description: The form's question-sequence record and the score-rule, segment-rule and follow-up-sequence records that decide the segment, as a store lists them
The records the answers make: answer facts, the segment assignment, owner action requests

provenance.source: bitfield-packages packages/ask-questions-sort-answers-follow-up (its record builders and readers); the tools answer their result and keep nothing

payload.label: Form results
payload.job: Show who answered a form, the score each earned and the segment each was sorted into, with a count per segment, from the segment assignments it is given
payload.description: Give records (the segment-assignment records, as a store lists them) and optionally a form_id to see one form, or nothing to see every form in them. Returns rows (respondentId, formId, segmentId, score, decidedAt), newest decision first, and a summary with the total and a count per segment. No assignments gives an empty list, never an invented one.

records.description: The segment-assignment records, as a store lists them

provenance.source: bitfield-packages packages/ask-questions-sort-answers-follow-up (its record builders and readers); the tools answer their result and keep nothing

payload.label: Answers over time
payload.job: Show one person's answers to a form across every time they answered, in order, and the trend of one numeric answer, from the answer facts it is given
payload.description: Give form_id, respondent_id, field_map (the name you want for each answer, to its questionId) and records (the answer-fact records, as a store lists them), and optionally trend_field (which mapped answer to chart; default the first that is numeric). Returns one row per time answered, oldest first, with the mapped answers and when; the numeric series for the trend; the latest row; and the count. A person who has not answered gets no rows.

respondent_id.description: The person whose answers to read

records.description: The answer-fact records, as a store lists them

provenance.source: bitfield-packages packages/ask-questions-sort-answers-follow-up (its record builders and readers); the tools answer their result and keep nothing

payload.label: Latest answers as lines
payload.job: Give the latest answers to a form as plain lines, each starting with the question it answers, ready to hand to a writer or a summary, from the records it is given
payload.description: Give form_id, records (the form's question-sequence record and its answer-fact records, as a store lists them) and optionally respondent_id. Returns lines: the most recent time the form was answered, one "Question: answer" line per non-empty answer (the bare answer when the question's label is not known).

records.description: The form's question-sequence record and its answer-fact records, as a store lists them
